summary: Frontend-only verification of the three new right-sidebar features (Divider 'Match Neighbor' far-side auto color, Shape 'Preset Thumbnails' with real values, and new Text FX tab) plus regression across divider snap, shape built-in presets, and all 12 inspector tabs. Zero console errors.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: added 'Large Header' (#ffffff) + 'Dark Navbar' (#0b0b0b) blocks to canvas; localStorage key 'webdojo_shape_presets' written and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Iteration 17 verified all three features work end-to-end:

1) Divider 'Match Neighbor' (divider-match-neighbor):
   - Disabled when placement=='end' (divider-place-end) — verified by is_disabled().
   - Disabled when there is no section on the far side (e.g. above at index 0 with no neighbour) — logic: neighborIndex = placement=='above' ? selIndex-1 : selIndex+1.
   - With selection=Large Header (index 0, #ffffff) and placement=divider-place-below, clicking divider-match-neighbor updated divider-color-hex to '#0b0b0b' (the FAR/below section = Dark Navbar). Confirms it picks the far side, NOT the selected block.
   - With selection=Dark Navbar (index 1, #0b0b0b) and placement=divider-place-above, divider-color-hex became '#ffffff' (far side = Large Header above).
   - divider-match-color still matches SELECTED block's own bg (Dark Navbar -> '#0b0b0b').

2) Shape 'Preset Thumbnails':
   - Configured shape-corner-squircle + shape-shadow-glow, typed 'MyTestPreset' in shape-preset-name, clicked shape-save-preset -> toast 'Saved preset "MyTestPreset"'.
   - New chip div[data-testid^='shape-preset-custom-'] renders with INNER preview box inline-style containing the REAL saved patch values: 'border-radius:20px', 'corner-shape:squircle', 'box-shadow:0 0 24px 2px rgba(59,130,246,0.55)'. Backdrop container uses linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(238, 242, 255), rgb(219, 226, 239)) — the light backdrop (browser serialised #eef2ff/#dbe2ef as rgb()).
   - Clicking the custom chip with a canvas element selected patched the element's first-tag inline style (squircle + box-shadow now present in canvas-el html).
   - Built-in shape-preset-glass regression: still applies backdrop-filter to selection.

3) Text FX tab (insp-tab-textfx / text-fx-panel):
   - Tab present as 9th of 12 tabs. Panel renders on click.
   - textfx-static-sunset on selected block -> element html contains 'background-image', 'background-clip:text', '-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent'.
   - textfx-anim-shimmer -> element html contains 'animation' and 'background-size' AND a <style> containing '@keyframes wdtfx_shimmer' is present in document.
   - textfx-hover-lift -> element root tag gains a class matching /wd-tfx-[a-z0-9]+/ AND a <style data-wd-tfx="<cls>"> containing ':hover' and 'translateY' is injected.
   - textfx-clear -> element html compact contains 'animation:none' and 'text-shadow:none'.
   - No-selection toast: after page reload with nothing selected, clicking textfx-static-sunset shows toast 'Select a text element (H1–H6, p, button…) first'.

4) Regressions verified: divider snap (below + insert grows canvas 2->3), shape-preset-glass applies backdrop-filter, all 12 insp-tab-* buttons exist and switch (color, gradient, style, shape, bg, blend, divider, anim, textfx, theme, cdn, page).

Console errors: 0 across all flows.

No-op / no bugs found. Main agent may self-verify; no re-test needed.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - all features work as specified.
